description: This file defines the AwsClientInterface interface for AWS SDK PHP, specifying methods for executing commands, retrieving configuration, and managing AWS service interactions.

classes.name: AwsClientInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for AWS client operations, including command execution, configuration retrieval, and resource management.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for commands, including async operations.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object for a specified AWS operation.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with AWS credentials.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the AWS region configured for the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the default endpoint URL for the client.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the service description associated with the client.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a specific or all client configuration options.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used for transferring commands.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator for a specified operation.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for a specified operation.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Waits until a resource reaches a specified state.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Retrieves a waiter object for asynchronous resource state waiting.
